description: Source code for TLS credentials shell command interface in Zephyr RTOS, providing functions to add, delete, retrieve, list, and buffer TLS credentials via shell commands.

methods.name: find_ref_slot
methods.description: Finds an empty or matching slot in the credential references array.

methods.name: filter_nonprint
methods.description: Filters out non-printable characters from a string.

methods.name: check_numeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: cred_buf_write
methods.description: Writes a chunk of data into the credential buffer.

methods.name: cred_type_name
methods.description: Returns human-readable name of a TLS credential type.

methods.name: cred_type_name_compact
methods.description: Returns compact name of a TLS credential type.

methods.name: shell_parse_cred_sectag
methods.description: Parses a shell argument into a credential section tag.

methods.name: shell_parse_cred_type
methods.description: Parses a shell argument into a credential type.

methods.name: shell_parse_cred_backend
methods.description: Parses a shell argument into a credential backend specifier.

methods.name: shell_parse_cred_storage_format
methods.description: Parses a shell argument into a credential storage format.

methods.name: shell_clear_cred_buf
methods.description: Clears the credential buffer with shell feedback.

methods.name: shell_write_cred_buf
methods.description: Writes data into the credential buffer with shell feedback.

methods.name: tls_cred_cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a TLS credential to the store based on shell input.

methods.name: tls_cred_cmd_buf
methods.description: Buffers credential data into the credential buffer.

methods.name: tls_cred_cmd_del
methods.description: Deletes a TLS credential from the store.

methods.name: tls_cred_cmd_get
methods.description: Retrieves a TLS credential's data from the store.

methods.name: tls_cred_cmd_list
methods.description: Lists stored TLS credentials with optional filtering.
